note: The 30-day clean-up of the person's own Google Drive (S4b-BL-293, docs/15 section 5.1, docs/03 section 20): which deleted photos' encrypted files leave Drive. Not part of any backup or sync format. A file is taken when its photo's tombstone is more than `windowDays` days before `now` AND strictly older than the oldest backup that stays (`oldestStayingBackupAgoMs`, milliseconds before `now`; null when no backup stays). `deletedAgoMs` is milliseconds before `now`; `driveFileId` null means none is known. `expect` lists the Drive file ids to take, in order, each once. The vectors are never edited to make a test pass.

cases.name: a file older than the window is taken when no backup stays
a file at exactly the window is kept
a file one millisecond older than the window is taken
a file is taken when the oldest staying backup was made after the deletion
a file is kept when the oldest staying backup predates the deletion
a file is kept when the oldest staying backup was made at the very moment of the deletion
a file inside the window is kept even when a backup was made after it
a file inside the window is kept when no backup stays
a file inside the window is kept when an older backup stays
a photo with no Drive file named is skipped
a file named by two photos is returned once
only the photos that qualify are swept, in order
